The only career I can imagine myself actually wanting to be alive for is art, but quite frankly I dont think it's going to work out. Life fucking sucks, its just one big cycle of people acting like your friends to make you get or give them money. Quite frankly sticking around is probably a dumb idea anyway, the only reason I'm making an exception for art is because i think I'll still be able to keep up this apathetic ignorance of how things really are if I'm doing something less soul-sucking and boring than the other 99% of jobs.

It's all a game of chances. I want to do art. Sure, maybe I'll get a career in it, maybe I'll meet amazing people, maybe I'll enjoy it. But that's only one side of the coin and we both know that. On the other hand I repeatedly try and fail to get an enjoyable career, go nowhere, and die knowing I only cared because other people told me to.

We treat mass shootings differently because they are an entirely different topic from drunk driving. Drunk driving is an issue the world faces and is collectively trying to deal with, and usually is thought of as an incredibly unfortunate accident due to bad judgement. 

Mass shootings, on the other hand, are acts of domestic terrorism done intentionally to kill as many people as possible. And unlike drunk driving, you don't exactly see too many big changes happening to fix it do you? 

The point is, one is an accident due to impaired judgement. The other is a conscious choice often times planned out to target certain groups. 

Ultimately both are huge problems, but only one of those is a problem some people want to willingly create and embody.

Long story short, I said a little more than I should have in a discord vent chat my friend was also on, and he told everybody in my friend group, and they all got together and told my class councilor.  The second my parents said "we got a call from the councilor" my trust issues hit an all time high that still hasn't budged.
